**Finding: COMPLIANT — no redline proposed.**

The AUDIT rule targets audit/inspection rights binding *us* (the Issuer/Depositor). This Agreement contains none. Every review and access mechanic runs in our favour against Cellco:

- **§ 3.6 (p0131)** – *we* (Issuer, Depositor, Parent Support Provider, Administrator, Owner Trustee, Indenture Trustee) get access to the **Servicer's** records, once per calendar year, on reasonable notice, at the Servicer's offices during normal business hours.
- **§ 3.4(e) (p0146)** – the **Custodian** must give the Depositor, Issuer and Indenture Trustee access to Receivable Files and receivables systems.
- **§ 6.6/6.7 (p0302–p0312)** – Servicer compliance statement, Reg AB servicing assessment and an **independent accounting firm's attestation** delivered to us (certification form at p1048).
- **Article XI (p0441–p0447)** – Servicer must support an **independent Asset Representations Reviewer**, with PII redacted.

No provision permits the counterparty to audit us or to access our systems, so the outcome sits above the preferred position. Consistent with the playbook, we do not flag provisions that benefit our party, and we did not manufacture an audit right against ourselves to "complete" elements.
